question: What intense experience at the tip of nectar can affect even a wise practitioner?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
An essence of juice is involved
Even the wise one experiences burning
inference: Therefore even a wise practitioner may feel burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of juice.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is not explicit.
plain_english: Even the wise one may feel burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
